input.goal: Create a single self-contained index.html: an interactive full-viewport HTML5 Canvas orbital particle simulation in dark space, with a glassmorphism HUD. Zero external dependencies, all CSS and JS inline, valid JavaScript.
constraints: Only file: index.html. No external scripts, fonts, images or CSS links (no http/https URLs in src or href).
UI text in English.
body background and canvas clear color #060913; html/body margin 0, overflow hidden.

One <canvas id="sim"> sized to the full window; on resize set canvas.width = innerWidth*devicePixelRatio, canvas.height = innerHeight*devicePixelRatio, CSS size 100vw/100vh, and ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0).
Animation loop uses requestAnimationFrame; simulation advances by real dt (seconds, clamped to 0.05) times app.speed, only when app.running is true.
Central star at canvas center drawn with ctx.createRadialGradient (white core -> #ffd76a -> #ff9a3c -> transparent) plus a corona whose radius pulses subtly with Math.sin of time.

At least 6 planets in app.planets, each object {name, radius (orbital px), speed (rad/s), size, color, angle, trail: []}; orbital radii all distinct, speeds all distinct, colors all distinct. Scale orbital radii to fit min(width,height) of the viewport.
At least 3 moons total in app.moons, each {parent (index into app.planets), radius, speed, size, color, angle}, orbiting their parent planet.
Orbital trails: each planet keeps recent positions in trail (max ~80 points) drawn as a line whose alpha fades from 0 at the oldest to ~0.6 at the newest. Faint thin orbit circles are also drawn.
Background starfield app.stars with at least 200 stars {x,y,r,phase,twinkleSpeed}; each star alpha = 0.3+0.7*abs(sin(t*twinkleSpeed+phase)) so they twinkle. Stars twinkle even when paused.

Glassmorphism HUD <div id="hud"> fixed top-left: background rgba(255,255,255,0.08), backdrop-filter: blur(12px) (and -webkit-backdrop-filter), border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18), border-radius 16px, padding 16px, color #e6ecff, font system-ui, box-shadow 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4).
Button id="btn-play": toggles app.running; text 'Pause' when running, 'Play' when paused.
Button id="btn-trails": toggles app.trails (default true); text 'Trails: ON' / 'Trails: OFF'. When off, trails are not drawn and trail arrays are cleared.

Button id="btn-reset": sets app.time = 0, resets every planet and moon angle to its initial value, clears all trails, empties app.particles, sets app.speed = 1 and the slider to 1.0, sets app.running = true.

Speed slider exactly <input type="range" id="speed" min="0.2" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0">; on 'input' event sets app.speed = parseFloat(value) and updates <span id="speed-val"> to value.toFixed(1)+'x' (e.g. '1.0x', '2.5x').
Stats in HUD: <span id="fps"> FPS (integer, updated ~every 0.5s), <span id="time"> app.time formatted toFixed(1)+' s', <span id="count"> = app.particles.length, updated every frame.
Buttons styled: background rgba(255,255,255,0.1), border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25), border-radius 10px, color #e6ecff, padding 6px 12px, cursor pointer, hover background rgba(255,255,255,0.2).

Mousedown/click on the canvas (not the HUD) spawns 60 particles at the click point (CSS px) via app.spawnBurst(x, y): each {x,y,vx,vy,life,maxLife,color,size} with random angle, speed 80-320 px/s, life 1.0-2.0 s, hue-random bright color. Expose app.spawnBurst.

Particles: each update vx,vy *= Math.pow(0.04, dt) (velocity damping), position += v*dt, life -= dt; removed when life <= 0; drawn with globalCompositeOperation 'lighter' and alpha = life/maxLife (fade-out) with a small radial glow. Particles update while running.
Expose window.app = {running, trails, speed, time, fps, planets, moons, stars, particles, spawnBurst} as live state (same object mutated by the loop).
verify_commands: tandem:ui_test {"steps":[{"exists":"canvas#sim"},{"exists":"#hud"},{"js":"window.app && app.planets.length>=5 && app.moons.length>=3 && app.stars.length>=150"},{"js":"new Set(app.planets.map(p=>p.radius)).size===app.planets.length && new Set(app.planets.map(p=>p.speed)).size===app.planets.length && new Set(app.planets.map(p=>p.color)).size===app.planets.length"},{"js":"document.querySelector('#speed').min==='0.2' && document.querySelector('#speed').max==='3.0' && document.querySelector('#speed').step==='0.1'"},{"expect":"moving"},{"click":"#btn-play"},{"js":"app.running===false && /Play/.test(document.querySelector('#btn-play').textContent)"},{"click":"#btn-play"},{"js":"app.running===true"},{"click":"#btn-trails"},{"js":"app.trails===false && /OFF/.test(document.querySelector('#btn-trails').textContent)"},{"click":"#btn-trails"},{"input":"#speed","value":"2.5"},{"js":"app.speed===2.5 && document.querySelector('#speed-val').textContent.includes('2.5')"},{"js":"app.spawnBurst(300,300); app.particles.length>=60 && Number(document.querySelector('#count').textContent)>=0"},{"click":"#btn-reset"},{"js":"app.particles.length===0 && app.speed===1 && app.time<0.5"},{"js":"/s/.test(document.querySelector('#time').textContent) && document.querySelector('#fps')!==null"}]}

content.text:
I had Tandem build `index.html` and it passed every check, though not on the first run. The first run stopped when it hit its time limit, so I sent it back once with a hint and the second run finished.

The page uses no external files and has everything you listed:
- **Canvas:** fills the window and stays sharp on high-density screens.
- **Star:** glowing, with a softly pulsing outer glow.
- **Planets:** 6, each with its own orbit size, speed and color, fading trails and faint orbit lines.
- **Moons:** at least 3.
- **Starfield:** 200 twinkling stars.
- **Control panel:** frosted-glass, top-left, with Play/Pause, Trails ON/OFF, Reset, the 0.2–3.0 speed slider with a live "1.0x" readout, and live FPS, simulation time and particle count.
- **Bursts:** clicking the canvas sends out 60 glowing particles that slow down and fade.

The checks ran in a headless Chromium browser. They confirmed the planet, moon and star counts, that every button and the slider work, that bursts spawn, and that Reset clears everything. I didn't open the page myself, so the look hasn't been checked by eye. Open `index.html` in a browser to see it.
